classes.name: PageAgent
classes.description: Represents an agent capable of performing actions, extracting information, and emitting events in a page context within the Playwright framework.

methods.name: PageAgent.dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the agent, releasing any resources.

methods.name: PageAgent.expect
methods.description: Sets an expectation for the page, asserting that a specific condition is met.

parameters.name: expectation
parameters.description: The condition to expect, e.g., '"0 items" to be reported'.

methods.description: Extracts information from the page using the agentic loop, returning data structured according to a schema.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The task or query to perform.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Schema defining the expected structure of the extracted data.

methods.name: PageAgent.perform
methods.description: Performs a specified task within the page context using the agentic loop.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: The task to perform, e.g., 'Click submit button'.
